# Fahali MCP Server
> Model Context Protocol server for Fahali's autonomous market-risk intelligence. An ensemble of independent detection engines scanning ~2,000 live markets (crypto + US equities/ETFs), real-time anomaly detection with verified signal→outcome provenance. The live roster and each engine's judged record are published at https://app.fahaliai.com/api/track-record/engines — the edge is in the composition, not the count. Informational only — not financial advice.

## Endpoints
- [SSE transport](https://mcp.fahaliai.com/sse)
- [Messages endpoint](https://mcp.fahaliai.com/messages?sessionId={sessionId})
- [Health](https://mcp.fahaliai.com/health)
- [Landing page](https://mcp.fahaliai.com/)
- [llms.txt](https://mcp.fahaliai.com/llms.txt)

## Authentication
Clients should use OAuth or provide a Fahali API key in the `Authorization: Bearer <FAHALI_API_KEY>` header. The legacy query-string key remains compatible for installed clients but should not be used in new integrations because URLs are commonly logged.
Create a key at https://app.fahaliai.com/developer

## Tools
The live catalogue is returned by `fahali_get_capabilities` and MCP `tools/list`; no static count is authoritative.

### Markets & verdict
- fahali_get_market_decision — primary market judgment: what changed, why it matters, horizon, evidence, conflicts, justified action and invalidation conditions (Professional; Free developer-key depth available)
- fahali_get_symbol_decision — the same canonical judgment contract bound to exactly one requested instrument (Professional; Free developer-key depth available)
- fahali_get_market_verdict — compatibility name for the canonical decision path (Professional)
- fahali_get_market_snapshot — live prices, changes, asset class for all instruments (Free)
- fahali_get_market_regime — HMM 4-regime detection (Professional)
- fahali_get_market_mood — how fearful or greedy prices are, US stocks and crypto, each measure ranked against its own past; a description, not a forecast (Free)
- fahali_get_sector_rotation — which sectors, coins and markets are leading or fading against their benchmark; relative price performance, not money flow (Free)
- fahali_get_market_sentiment — sentiment history with score and direction (Free)
- fahali_get_highest_conviction_signals — priority risk clusters; risk conviction and directional conviction are reported separately, and stress conviction is never presented as a trade direction (Free)
- fahali_daily_brief — yesterday vs today market intelligence diff (Free teaser / Professional)

### Risk & crash
- fahali_get_market_risk_score — global 0-100 market-risk context from the canonical detection snapshot; not participant or portfolio risk (Professional)
- fahali_get_flash_crash_risk — uncalibrated early-warning strength, observed triggers and risk flags; calibrated crash probability, timing and action are withheld unless a matching model exists (Professional)
- fahali_get_portfolio_risk — VaR, drawdown, per-position breakdown from connected accounts (Elite)
- fahali_analyze_custom_portfolio — stateless risk, canonical direction reconciliation and covariance coverage for a supplied book; binding action withheld (Elite)
- fahali_run_shock_test — natural-language stress test with capital at risk (Free)

### Detection activity & flow proxies
- fahali_get_detection_activity — per-symbol detection counts and bullish-versus-bearish alert-type balance; alert activity, not executed trade flow (Professional)
- fahali_get_unusual_money_movement — participant-agnostic, candle-derived buy-versus-sell volume imbalance with conflicts and freshness explicit (Professional)
- fahali_get_microstructure_proxy — absorption observations derived from public aggregate trades and order-book snapshots, with source and limitations explicit (Professional)
- fahali_get_capital_flow — measured 60-minute USD buy-vs-sell imbalance for requested symbols, or the strongest available readings; candle-derived proxy, and zero detector score does not mean no data (Professional)
- fahali_get_forecast — crash/pump/neutral probabilities with a p10/p50/p90 uncertainty cone over the registered horizon (Professional)
- fahali_get_lead_time — per engine: measured hours of warning ahead of correct calls, misses included. Quote `headline` for a single claim: it is selected server-side by recall among strata clearing the publication floor with positive base-rate lift. Do not cherry-pick a row. If no headline is publishable, report `headlineWithheldReason`. Always name its instrument class and horizon (Free)
- fahali_get_market_briefing — full executive market analysis for today; PARTIAL when subsystems disagree (Professional)

### Contagion & correlation
- fahali_get_contagion_map — contagion graph with tail-dependence edges (Elite)
- fahali_get_correlation_matrix — requested-book Pearson matrix from the canonical 45-day covariance artifact, with pair observations and coverage (Free)

### Portfolio & alerts
- fahali_get_portfolio_metrics — sentiment momentum, cascade risk, liquidity stress (Professional)
- fahali_get_realtime_alerts — unified detection feed from the active fleet (Professional)

### Persistent monitoring, history & delivery
- fahali_watch_portfolio — persist supplied positions or connected accounts together with objective, horizon, drawdown tolerance, position limit and permitted actions; evaluates immediately and in the background (Elite)
- fahali_list_portfolio_watches — resume existing watches instead of recreating them (Elite)
- fahali_update_portfolio_watch — change positions, mandate, thresholds, cadence or active state and immediately re-evaluate (Elite)
- fahali_get_portfolio_decision — current HOLD/WATCH/REDUCE/EXIT judgment with what happened, why, when, what now and what invalidates it (Elite)
- fahali_get_watch_delta — exact decision and evidence changes since the prior immutable verdict (Elite)
- fahali_get_verdict_history — cursor, symbol, since and as_of queries over immutable watch judgments (Elite)
- fahali_get_verdict_by_id — permanent replay of one judgment and its integrity hashes (Elite)
- fahali_subscribe_risk — signed webhook/agent callback, Slack, Teams, account-email or registered-device delivery (Elite)
- fahali_list_risk_subscriptions — channel health and filters without secrets or full targets (Elite)
- fahali_update_subscription — pause, resume, filter or rotate a target (Elite)
- fahali_unsubscribe_risk — stop delivery while retaining the audit record (Elite)

Persistent delivery is outbox-backed, deduplicated and retried. A failed channel is recorded as failed; it is never described as sent. Webhook targets are public HTTPS only, configuration is encrypted, redirects are refused and generic callbacks are signed with HMAC-SHA256.

### Proof & system
- fahali_get_track_record_scorecard — honest 4-axis accuracy with base-rate lift (Professional)
- fahali_get_case_studies — 40 verified signal→outcome cases (Professional)
- fahali_get_engine_status — liveness report for the active detection fleet (Free)
- fahali_get_visual_intelligence — unified constellation graph of the active fleet (Free)

### Agent workflow & private state
- fahali_get_bundle — one-call composite of selected market and portfolio views with shared context deduplicated (Professional)
- fahali_get_capabilities — canonical executable tool inventory, tiers, response controls and resources (Free)
- fahali_list_connected_accounts — safe account enumeration before portfolio analysis (Professional)
- fahali_fact_check_narrative — verify each assertion before an agent repeats it (Professional)
- fahali_save_memory — save private agent context with a namespaced key (Free)
- fahali_search_memories — query private saved agent context (Free)
- fahali_create_alert — create an idempotent agent-authored alert (Elite)
- fahali_list_agent_sessions — enumerate the caller's private agent sessions (Free)

## Company
Future Legends Inc — Fahali measures how much warning arrived before an adverse market move, and publishes the record it is scored against, including the misses. Read-only: it observes and scores, it routes no orders. Observation, not investment advice.
